title: Diffraction
design_rationale: Teach diffraction as a distinct spreading phenomenon before introducing two-source interference or grating calculations.
concepts_taught: explain the meaning of the term diffraction

show an understanding of experiments that demonstrate diffraction including the qualitative effect of the gap width relative to the wavelength of the wave; for example diffraction of water waves in a ripple tank
